_advertencia: MUESTRA DE REFERENCIA PARA DEMOSTRACION SIN CONEXION. Los criterios de elegibilidad estan resumidos y no sustituyen al protocolo original de cada estudio. Regenerar con datos reales mediante scripts/construir_cache_ensayos.py --regenerar antes de cualquier uso que no sea la demostracion del sistema.

estudios.titulo: Estudio de vorasidenib en glioma de bajo grado con mutacion de IDH
estudios.criterios: Inclusion: histologically confirmed grade 2 glioma with documented IDH1 or IDH2 mutation (IDH mutant). Residual or recurrent disease after surgery. No prior systemic anticancer therapy. Exclusion: IDH wild-type tumors. Prior radiotherapy for glioma. ABRIDGED SUMMARY, NOT THE FULL PROTOCOL.

estudios.titulo: Radioterapia con o sin quimioterapia en glioma de grado 2 con codeleccion 1p/19q
estudios.criterios: Inclusion: newly diagnosed grade 2 oligodendroglioma with 1p/19q co-deleted status confirmed by FISH and IDH mutant status. Exclusion: non-co-deleted tumors. ABRIDGED SUMMARY, NOT THE FULL PROTOCOL.

estudios.titulo: Terapia dirigida en glioblastoma con promotor de MGMT no metilado
estudios.criterios: Inclusion: newly diagnosed glioblastoma, IDH wild-type, with unmethylated MGMT promoter status. Karnofsky performance status 70 or higher. Exclusion: methylated MGMT promoter. ABRIDGED SUMMARY, NOT THE FULL PROTOCOL.

estudios.titulo: Inmunoterapia dirigida a EGFRvIII en glioblastoma recurrente
estudios.criterios: Inclusion: recurrent glioblastoma with documented EGFR amplification and EGFRvIII variant expression. IDH wild-type. Exclusion: absence of EGFRvIII. ABRIDGED SUMMARY, NOT THE FULL PROTOCOL.

estudios.titulo: Estudio de agente alquilante en glioma con promotor de MGMT metilado
estudios.criterios: Inclusion: high grade glioma with methylated MGMT promoter. Age 18 to 75 years. Adequate organ function. Exclusion: unmethylated MGMT promoter. ABRIDGED SUMMARY, NOT THE FULL PROTOCOL.

estudios.titulo: Estudio observacional de calidad de vida en tumores cerebrales primarios
estudios.criterios: Inclusion: adults with a primary brain tumor diagnosis undergoing active treatment. No molecular marker requirement. ABRIDGED SUMMARY, NOT THE FULL PROTOCOL.

estudios.titulo: Terapia de combinacion en astrocitoma IDH mutante de alto grado
estudios.criterios: Inclusion: grade 3 or 4 astrocytoma, IDH mutant, non-co-deleted 1p/19q. Prior radiotherapy permitted. Exclusion: IDH wild-type tumors, 1p/19q co-deleted tumors. ABRIDGED SUMMARY, NOT THE FULL PROTOCOL.

estudios.titulo: Estudio de inhibidor de TERT en glioma con mutacion del promotor
estudios.criterios: Inclusion: recurrent glioma with documented TERT promoter mutation (C228T or C250T). Exclusion: none specified for other markers. ABRIDGED SUMMARY, NOT THE FULL PROTOCOL.
